name: occupancy
question: Is the room occupied right now, and how confident are we? (Capstone C1 core)

sensors.role: fast channel (Absence of Evidence: silence is not emptiness)
slow integrator (Evidence With Latency: confirms or vetoes)
context gate (envelope-open marks CO2 invalid for occupancy)

reasoning_prompt: Fuse the four channels into an occupancy state (EMPTY / LOW_OCCUPANCY / OCCUPIED / ACTIVE). PIR silence alone must never produce EMPTY; require CO2 decay and SPL floor agreement. Mark any window where door_open=1 as envelope-open and exclude the CO2 evidence there. State the single most likely occupancy narrative and what evidence would change your mind.
